subject.description: Meta-destruction of the method accumulated in the composite dossier.

PROTOCOL_VORGRIFF.note: The dossier names several preferences of its method, but no independent reviewer has attested the completeness of this inventory.

CODE_INFLATION.note: The file explicitly worries about checklist inflation while itself expanding to 697 pages; the practical balance is unresolved.

INDEPENDENT_REDESCRIPTION.note: No separately frozen, vocabulary-neutral redescription of the full dossier was found.

SELF_CONFIRMATION.note: Many internal objections are present, but their ability to eliminate the project vocabulary rather than enrich it remains untested.
